text: Chimera Investment LLC, the Abu Dhabi fund that owns a majority of Colnago, is part of a business empire overseen by Abu Dhabi's Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan.
short: Chimera (Colnago's majority owner) is part of Sheikh Tahnoon's business empire

source.name: Bloomberg Law: Abu Dhabi Royal's Firm Sets Up $50 Billion Investing Force (Archana Narayanan)
source.quote: Chimera Investment LLC, part of a business empire overseen by Abu Dhabi's Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, set up a $50 billion fund
source.note: Reuters (15 Sep 2023) puts it as: 'Chimera is part of Sheikh Tahnoun's private investment firm Royal Group' — reuters.com 403s scripts, so the Reuters page itself is not linked as a checked source.
